s0101.literal: An imperial-seal edict was issued reaffirming the prohibition on the salt monopoly law.
s0101.idiomatic: An imperial-seal edict was issued reaffirming the prohibition on the salt monopoly law.

s0102.literal: The rent and tax submitted by forty thousand households of the people of Chongde County, Jiaxing Route, was used to supply the annual grants of money and silks to Yingzong's consorts.
s0102.idiomatic: The rent and tax submitted by 40,000 households of the people of Chongde County, Jiaxing Route, was used to supply the annual grants of money and silks to Yingzong's consorts.

s0103.literal: An edict instructed the Privy Council: use ten thousand ingots of notes from garrison-field grain to assist in building a Buddhist temple, and exempt its soldiers from corvée labor on construction and earthworks.
s0103.idiomatic: An edict instructed the Privy Council: use 10,000 ingots of notes from garrison-field grain to assist in building a Buddhist temple, and exempt its soldiers from corvée labor on construction and earthworks.

s0104.literal: On gengxu day, the people of Chaling Prefecture were famished; associate administrator Wanjienu and Jiang Cunli pawned the edict they had received to obtain three thousand shi of grain for relief.
s0104.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the people of Chaling Prefecture were famished; associate administrator Wanjienu and Jiang Cunli pawned the edict they had received to obtain 3,000 shi of grain for relief.

s0105.literal: On xinhai day, Mongol relay households of the Remote West were famished; fodder and grain were granted in graded amounts.
s0105.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Mongol relay households of the Remote West were famished; fodder and grain were granted in graded amounts.

s0106.literal: Five thousand ingots of notes were dispensed to relieve Henan migrants returning home.
s0106.idiomatic: 5,000 ingots of notes were dispensed to relieve Henan migrants returning home.

s0107.literal: Three thousand famine households in Tai'an Prefecture, seven thousand seven hundred in Nangong County of Zhending, eighteen thousand two hundred in Songjiang Prefecture, and famine within the Tibetan Dolijis Altimish wanhu command — the local offices in each place were ordered to relieve according to circumstances.
s0107.idiomatic: 3,000 famine households in Tai'an Prefecture, 7,700 in Nangong County of Zhending, 18,200 in Songjiang Prefecture, and famine within the Tibetan Dolijis Altimish wanhu command — the local offices in each place were ordered to relieve according to circumstances.

s0108.literal: Forty-four thousand nine hundred famine households in Jining Route were relieved with ten thousand ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy.
s0108.idiomatic: 44,900 famine households in Jining Route were relieved with 10,000 ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy.

s0109.literal: Hangzhou suffered fire; one month of relief grain was dispensed.
s0109.idiomatic: Hangzhou suffered fire; 1 month of relief grain was dispensed.

s0110.literal: Orders were issued to purchase fields of the former Duke of Ying Zhao Xian to serve as perpetual endowment for the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple.
s0110.idiomatic: Orders were issued to purchase fields of the former Duke of Ying Zhao Xian to serve as perpetual endowment for the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple.

s0111.literal: Censorate officials said there was no need to give payment; the Emperor said: "I build the temple for the sake of posterity and the common people; if I take men's fields without giving payment, that is not my intent.
s0111.idiomatic: Censorate officials said there was no need to give payment; the Emperor said: "I build the temple for the sake of posterity and the common people; if I take men's fields without giving payment, that is not my intent.

s0112.literal: Fourteen thousand four hundred fifty-six famished persons among the guard units of qianhu Chala and others under the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission — each was given one ingot of notes.
s0112.idiomatic: 14,456 famished persons among the guard units of qianhu Chala and others under the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission — each was given 1 ingot of notes.

s0113.literal: Third month, on jiayin day, the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supply the spirit-shrine hall sacrifices for Empress Xianyi Zhuangsheng.
s0113.idiomatic: Third month, on jiayin day, the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supply the spirit-shrine hall sacrifices for Empress Xianyi Zhuangsheng.

s0114.literal: Three thousand Guai Xi barbarians entered Songli Mountain and burned border garrison camps and forts.
s0114.idiomatic: 3,000 Guai Xi barbarians entered Songli Mountain and burned border garrison camps and forts.

s0115.literal: Xucheng County of Dongping Route was famished; relief was given with notes from the Shandong salt levy.
s0115.idiomatic: Xucheng County of Dongping Route was famished; relief was given with notes from the Shandong salt levy.

s0116.literal: The five routes Anqing, Anfeng, Qi, Huang, and Lu were famished; relief was given with notes from the Huai-Xi surveillance commission's fines and confiscations.
s0116.idiomatic: The 5 routes Anqing, Anfeng, Qi, Huang, and Lu were famished; relief was given with notes from the Huai-Xi surveillance commission's fines and confiscations.

s0117.literal: On dingsi day, Prince of Jiyang Munai was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Wu; Prince of Wu Popi was made Prince of Jiyang.
s0117.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Prince of Jiyang Munai was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Wu; Prince of Wu Popi was made Prince of Jiyang.

s0118.literal: Each of the native officials of the Eight Tribes Shunyuan, Qujing, Wusa, Wumeng, Mengqing, Luolosi, and Songming Prefecture was granted one bolt of silks and cloth.
s0118.idiomatic: Each of the native officials of the Eight Tribes Shunyuan, Qujing, Wusa, Wumeng, Mengqing, Luolosi, and Songming Prefecture was granted 1 bolt of silks and cloth.

s0119.literal: Indiscriminate grants at relays were prohibited.
s0119.idiomatic: Indiscriminate grants at relays were prohibited.

s0120.literal: Sichuan officials who had been coerced into following Nangjiatai were all restored to their former posts.
s0120.idiomatic: Sichuan officials who had been coerced into following Nangjiatai were all restored to their former posts.

s0121.literal: On wuwu day, the prince Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed Prince of Yan; a palace chancellor's office was established to oversee his household affairs, rank 2a, with Yan Temür in charge.
s0121.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the prince Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed Prince of Yan; a palace chancellor's office was established to oversee his household affairs, rank 2a, with Yan Temür in charge.

s0122.literal: The palace examination for jinshi was held; ninety-seven persons including Dolatu and Wang Wenye were granted ranked pass and origin status in varying grades.
s0122.idiomatic: The palace examination for jinshi was held; 97 persons including Dolatu and Wang Wenye were granted ranked pass and origin status in varying grades.

s0123.literal: Zhangde Route was ordered to perform annual sacrifices at the Zhou King Wen shrine in Youli.
s0123.idiomatic: Zhangde Route was ordered to perform annual sacrifices at the Zhou King Wen shrine in Youli.

s0124.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor; Eight Tribes Shunyuan pacification commissioner Timur Buqa was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor — to campaign against Yunnan with the Prince of Yu by the Eight Tribes route.
s0124.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor; Eight Tribes Shunyuan pacification commissioner Timur Buqa was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor — to campaign against Yunnan with the Prince of Yu by the Eight Tribes route.

s0125.literal: Mingzong's seventy close attendants were granted offices in varying grades.
s0125.idiomatic: Mingzong's 70 close attendants were granted offices in varying grades.

s0126.literal: Three thousand bodyguards of Yuzong's and Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng's tablet shrines — the Stored Governance Court was ordered to supply their clothing, grain, fodder, and provisions.
s0126.idiomatic: 3,000 bodyguards of Yuzong's and Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng's tablet shrines — the Stored Governance Court was ordered to supply their clothing, grain, fodder, and provisions.

s0127.literal: One hundred thousand shi of rice was issued to sell grain in relief to the capital's poor.
s0127.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of rice was issued to sell grain in relief to the capital's poor.

s0128.literal: On guihai day, princes Sangqan, Satemish, and Maju were dispatched on separate missions to the northwest to princes Yaziqitai, Ozbeg, Közbeg, and others.
s0128.idiomatic: On guihai day, princes Sangqan, Satemish, and Maju were dispatched on separate missions to the northwest to princes Yaziqitai, Ozbeg, Közbeg, and others.

s0129.literal: On jiazi day, an edict announced to the empire: censor-in-chief Timur Buqa and Yuelu Buhua were ordered to revive censorate authority.
s0129.idiomatic: On jiazi day, an edict announced to the empire: censor-in-chief Timur Buqa and Yuelu Buhua were ordered to revive censorate authority.

s0130.literal: On dingmao day, Mubaraqsha came to offer tribute wine; notes and silks were granted in varying amounts.
s0130.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Mubaraqsha came to offer tribute wine; notes and silks were granted in varying amounts.

s0131.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve thirty-three thousand six hundred famine households in Dongchang.
s0131.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve 33,600 famine households in Dongchang.

s0132.literal: On jisi day, deliberation on elevating Mingzong to join the ancestral temple — ordering him above Yingzong, taking as precedent the cases of relocating Shunzong's and Chengzong's temples.
s0132.idiomatic: On jisi day, deliberation on elevating Mingzong to join the ancestral temple — ordering him above Yingzong, taking as precedent the cases of relocating Shunzong's and Chengzong's temples.

s0133.literal: On xinwei day, the hundred officials requested an honorific title for the Emperor; not granted; they pressed repeatedly without cease — then it was granted.
s0133.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the hundred officials requested an honorific title for the Emperor; not granted; they pressed repeatedly without cease — then it was granted.

s0134.literal: Privy council administrator Buhua Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Wuping commandery.
s0134.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Buhua Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Wuping commandery.

s0135.literal: The achievements of suppressing Yunnan's Tujan and Buqa were recorded; Yunnan pacification commissioner native officials Juzong and Lü Yu were both remotely appointed Yunnan Branch Secretariat associate administrators; Lü Yu's gifts were in varying amounts.
s0135.idiomatic: The achievements of suppressing Yunnan's Tujan and Buqa were recorded; Yunnan pacification commissioner native officials Juzong and Lü Yu were both remotely appointed Yunnan Branch Secretariat associate administrators; Lü Yu's gifts were in varying amounts.

s0136.literal: Longqing Prefecture was detached and made subordinate to Dadu Route.
s0136.idiomatic: Longqing Prefecture was detached and made subordinate to Dadu Route.

s0137.literal: More than seven hundred of Prince Yesutai's following entered Tianshan County and plundered people's property; Privy Council and Imperial Clan Court officials were dispatched to arrest them.
s0137.idiomatic: More than 700 of Prince Yesutai's following entered Tianshan County and plundered people's property; Privy Council and Imperial Clan Court officials were dispatched to arrest them.

s0138.literal: On renshen day, jade registers and jade seal were presented; Mingzong's spirit tablet was joined in the Grand Temple.
s0138.idiomatic: On renshen day, jade registers and jade seal were presented; Mingzong's spirit tablet was joined in the Grand Temple.

s0139.literal: Puzhou's Linqing and Guantao two counties were famished; seven thousand ingots of notes for relief.
s0139.idiomatic: Puzhou's Linqing and Guantao 2 counties were famished; 7,000 ingots of notes for relief.

s0140.literal: Guangshan County of Guang Prefecture was famished; ten thousand shi of government grain was released at reduced price for relief sale.
s0140.idiomatic: Guangshan County of Guang Prefecture was famished; 10,000 shi of government grain was released at reduced price for relief sale.

s0141.literal: Xinyang, Xi Prefecture, and Gushi County of Guang were famished; nearby granary grain was used to relieve them all.
s0141.idiomatic: Xinyang, Xi Prefecture, and Gushi County of Guang were famished; nearby granary grain was used to relieve them all.

s0142.literal: On jiaxu day, Prince Sulaiman was enfeoffed Prince of Xining.
s0142.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Prince Sulaiman was enfeoffed Prince of Xining.

s0143.literal: On yihai day, Western Tibet's Karakhoja came to offer tribute wine.
s0143.idiomatic: On yihai day, Western Tibet's Karakhoja came to offer tribute wine.

s0144.literal: Princes and consort kings returned to their garrisons; gifts were granted in varying amounts.
s0144.idiomatic: Princes and consort kings returned to their garrisons; gifts were granted in varying amounts.

s0145.literal: On bingzi day, the Shandong commander-in-chief's office was changed to a commander-in-chief prefecture.
s0145.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Shandong commander-in-chief's office was changed to a commander-in-chief prefecture.

s0146.literal: Yunnan's Mubang Route native official Hundu came to offer tribute goods.
s0146.idiomatic: Yunnan's Mubang Route native official Hundu came to offer tribute goods.

s0147.literal: Dengfeng, Yanshi, Mengjin and other counties of Henan were famished; thirty thousand ingots from the Two Huai salt levy were used for relief.
s0147.idiomatic: Dengfeng, Yanshi, Mengjin and other counties of Henan were famished; 30,000 ingots from the Two Huai salt levy were used for relief.

s0148.literal: Gongchang, Lintao, Lanzhou, and Dingxi Prefecture were famished; three thousand five hundred ingots for relief.
s0148.idiomatic: Gongchang, Lintao, Lanzhou, and Dingxi Prefecture were famished; 3,500 ingots for relief.

s0149.literal: Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai five prefectures were famished; five thousand shi of relief grain.
s0149.idiomatic: Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai 5 prefectures were famished; 5,000 shi of relief grain.

s0150.literal: Zhongxing, Xia, Guizhou, Anlu, and Mianyang — famine households exceeding three hundred thousand — four months of relief grain.
s0150.idiomatic: Zhongxing, Xia, Guizhou, Anlu, and Mianyang — famine households exceeding 300,000 — 4 months of relief grain.

s0151.literal: On dingchou day, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies was promoted to rank 2a.
s0151.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies was promoted to rank 2a.

s0152.literal: An edict ordered relevant offices to supply two hundred bolts of silks and cloth for the household allotment of Mingzong's consort Babusha, and silks and cloth for Atli and Toghos in varying amounts.
s0152.idiomatic: An edict ordered relevant offices to supply 200 bolts of silks and cloth for the household allotment of Mingzong's consort Babusha, and silks and cloth for Atli and Toghos in varying amounts.

s0153.literal: A stele recording Yan Temür's meritorious achievements was granted.
s0153.idiomatic: A stele recording Yan Temür's meritorious achievements was granted.

s0154.literal: Guangping Route was famished; thirteen thousand ingots from the Hejian salt levy were used for relief.
s0154.idiomatic: Guangping Route was famished; 13,000 ingots from the Hejian salt levy were used for relief.

s0155.literal: On xinsi day, Prince Qariman dispatched envoys to offer tribute wine.
s0155.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Prince Qariman dispatched envoys to offer tribute wine.

s0156.literal: Guangde, Taiping, Jiqing and other routes were famished — altogether several million households.
s0156.idiomatic: Guangde, Taiping, Jiqing and other routes were famished — altogether several million households.

s0157.literal: In Puzhou's various counties worms were eating mulberry leaves nearly to exhaustion.
s0157.idiomatic: In Puzhou's various counties worms were eating mulberry leaves nearly to exhaustion.

s0158.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu new moon — Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom; from this day it began, until the twelfth month when it ended.
s0158.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, renwu new moon — Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom; from this day it began, until the 12th month when it ended.

s0159.literal: On guiwei day, the Directorate General for provision lands and grain for qalan households was established, rank 3a.
s0159.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Directorate General for provision lands and grain for qalan households was established, rank 3a.

s0160.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Annual grants of money and silks to each palace allotment and bodyguard soldiers — the old quota was ten thousand men; last year it increased by four thousand; recently the increase has grown broader — we request it be appropriate to follow the old quota.
s0160.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Annual grants of money and silks to each palace allotment and bodyguard soldiers — the old quota was 10,000 men; last year it increased by 4,000; recently the increase has grown broader — we request it be appropriate to follow the old quota.

s0161.literal: An edict ordered Abuhaiya to deliberate reductions and report.
s0161.idiomatic: An edict ordered Abuhaiya to deliberate reductions and report.

s0162.literal: On jiashen day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.
s0162.idiomatic: On jiashen day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.

s0163.literal: On bingxu day, Yejin Buyan was enfeoffed Duke of the State of Huan.
s0163.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Yejin Buyan was enfeoffed Duke of the State of Huan.

s0164.literal: Yan Temür said: "At the start of Tianli, Ashiq soldiers toiled meritoriously for the state — I request one hundred thousand ingots of notes and one hundred thousand shi of rice be divided and given to their families.
s0164.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "At the start of Tianli, Ashiq soldiers toiled meritoriously for the state — I request 100,000 ingots of notes and 100,000 shi of rice be divided and given to their families.

s0166.literal: On wuzi day, Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized Chongqing's five-route ten-thousand households to send troops to rescue Yunnan.
s0166.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized Chongqing's five-route ten-thousand households to send troops to rescue Yunnan.

s0167.literal: On gengyin day, central secretariat officials said: "Recently the people in various places have been famished; relief has repeatedly been given; last year relief was one million three hundred forty-nine thousand six hundred-odd ingots of notes and two hundred fifty-one thousand seven hundred-odd shi of grain.
s0167.idiomatic: On gengyin day, central secretariat officials said: "Recently the people in various places have been famished; relief has repeatedly been given; last year relief was 1,349,600-odd ingots of notes and 251,700-odd shi of grain.

s0168.literal: Now Bianliang, Huaiqing, Zhangde, Daming, Xinghe, Weihui, Shunde, Guide and Gaotang, Tai'an, Xu, Pi, Cao, Guan and other prefectures have six hundred seventy-six thousand famine households, one million one hundred twenty thousand-odd mouths — we request ninety thousand ingots and fifteen thousand shi of rice; order the offices to divide relief.
s0168.idiomatic: Now Bianliang, Huaiqing, Zhangde, Daming, Xinghe, Weihui, Shunde, Guide and Gaotang, Tai'an, Xu, Pi, Cao, Guan and other prefectures have 676,000 famine households, 1,120,000-odd mouths — we request 90,000 ingots and 15,000 shi of rice; order the offices to divide relief.

s0170.literal: Because Shaanxi was famished, relevant offices were edicted to perform Buddhist rites for seven days.
s0170.idiomatic: Because Shaanxi was famished, relevant offices were edicted to perform Buddhist rites for 7 days.

s0171.literal: On renchen day, four hundred qing of fields belonging to Zhang Gui's sons that had been registered was granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.
s0171.idiomatic: On renchen day, 400 qing of fields belonging to Zhang Gui's sons that had been registered was granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.

s0172.literal: Eight thousand two hundred Mongol famine refugees among border tribes — each was given three ingots, two bolts of cloth, two months of grain, and sent back to their commands.
s0172.idiomatic: 8,200 Mongol famine refugees among border tribes — each was given 3 ingots, 2 bolts of cloth, 2 months of grain, and sent back to their commands.

s0173.literal: On guisi day, for the Prince of Yu, two each of tutor, deputy commandant, and marshal were established.
s0173.idiomatic: On guisi day, for the Prince of Yu, 2 each of tutor, deputy commandant, and marshal were established.

s0174.literal: On dingyou day, Prince Sang'ursun was dispatched back to Yunnan.
s0174.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Prince Sang'ursun was dispatched back to Yunnan.

s0175.literal: At Jinlan and other relays horses and oxen died; five hundred ingots of notes for relief.
s0175.idiomatic: At Jinlan and other relays horses and oxen died; 500 ingots of notes for relief.

s0176.literal: On gengzi day, an imperial-seal edict was sent to reaffirm instructions to the Court of Imperial Rites of Grand Felicity.
s0176.idiomatic: On gengzi day, an imperial-seal edict was sent to reaffirm instructions to the Court of Imperial Rites of Grand Felicity.

s0177.literal: Liling and Xiangyin of Tianlin Route, Linhai and other counties of Taizhou — each was famished; five thousand shi of relief-sale rice each.
s0177.idiomatic: Liling and Xiangyin of Tianlin Route, Linhai and other counties of Taizhou — each was famished; 5,000 shi of relief-sale rice each.

s0178.literal: On xinchou day, Mingzong's consort Babusha died.
s0178.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Mingzong's consort Babusha died.

s0179.literal: On renyin day, one hundred sixty-two thousand ninety qing of idle fields in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were surveyed and granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.
s0179.idiomatic: On renyin day, 162,090 qing of idle fields in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were surveyed and granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.

s0180.literal: The Yidu Broad Agriculture Intendant Office and intendant agencies in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were established — all subordinate to the Longxiang Directorate General.
s0180.idiomatic: The Yidu Broad Agriculture Intendant Office and intendant agencies in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were established — all subordinate to the Longxiang Directorate General.

s0181.literal: Wusa native official Lü Yu killed Wusa pacification commission officials and surrendered to Buqa.
s0181.idiomatic: Wusa native official Lü Yu killed Wusa pacification commission officials and surrendered to Buqa.

s0182.literal: All the Luoluo barbarians rebelled in concert with Buqa; grand councillor Timur Buqa was killed by them.
s0182.idiomatic: All the Luoluo barbarians rebelled in concert with Buqa; grand councillor Timur Buqa was killed by them.

s0183.literal: Jinning and Jianchang two routes' people were famished — fifty-five thousand shi of relief grain and twenty-three thousand ingots of notes.
s0183.idiomatic: Jinning and Jianchang 2 routes' people were famished — 55,000 shi of relief grain and 23,000 ingots of notes.

s0184.literal: On wushen day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate said: "Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang and other routes, because of successive years of famine, cannot obtain five-grain seed — we request twenty thousand ingots so they may divide purchases of grain in other prefectures.
s0184.idiomatic: On wushen day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate said: "Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang and other routes, because of successive years of famine, cannot obtain five-grain seed — we request 20,000 ingots so they may divide purchases of grain in other prefectures.

s0186.literal: Yunnan bandit Lü Yu with more than seven hundred barbarian troops blocked the Wusa-Shunyuan border, established passes and held firm.
s0186.idiomatic: Yunnan bandit Lü Yu with more than 700 barbarian troops blocked the Wusa-Shunyuan border, established passes and held firm.

s0187.literal: Chongqing five-route wanhu troops reached Yunnan's borders, encountered Luoluo barbarians — more than ten thousand men were killed; qianhu Zhu Tianxiang and others led the remainder in flight back.
s0187.idiomatic: Chongqing five-route wanhu troops reached Yunnan's borders, encountered Luoluo barbarians — more than 10,000 men were killed; qianhu Zhu Tianxiang and others led the remainder in flight back.

s0188.literal: An edict ordered Jiang-Zhe, Henan, and Jiangxi three branch secretariats to mobilize twenty thousand troops; Prince Yundushi Temür and privy council judge Hong Jia were ordered to lead them — to join Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tughuan's army in suppressing Yunnan.
s0188.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jiang-Zhe, Henan, and Jiangxi 3 branch secretariats to mobilize 20,000 troops; Prince Yundushi Temür and privy council judge Hong Jia were ordered to lead them — to join Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tughuan's army in suppressing Yunnan.

s0189.literal: On jiyou day, Buddhist rites were performed.
s0189.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Buddhist rites were performed.

s0190.literal: This month, in counties subordinate to Cangzhou and Gaotang Prefecture worms ate mulberry leaves entirely.
s0190.idiomatic: This month, in counties subordinate to Cangzhou and Gaotang Prefecture worms ate mulberry leaves entirely.

s0191.literal: Shaobo colony was famished; two months of relief grain.
s0191.idiomatic: Shaobo colony was famished; 2 months of relief grain.

s0192.literal: Tibetan areas' Tesima people were famished; relevant offices were ordered to relieve them.
s0192.idiomatic: Tibetan areas' Tesima people were famished; relevant offices were ordered to relieve them.

s0193.literal: One thousand ingots of notes to relieve Chen'en of Huaiqing, Meng Prefecture and other relays.
s0193.idiomatic: 1,000 ingots of notes to relieve Chen'en of Huaiqing, Meng Prefecture and other relays.

s0194.literal: Fifth month, on yimao day, Xuanhui commissioner Dingzhu and others were dispatched to announce and perform southern suburban sacrifices for receiving the honorific title.
s0194.idiomatic: Fifth month, on yimao day, Xuanhui commissioner Dingzhu and others were dispatched to announce and perform southern suburban sacrifices for receiving the honorific title.

s0195.literal: Former Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Kuanche, Sichuan Circuit surveillance commissioner Huduruyanga, and others — all were killed by Nangjiatai — posthumous offices and posthumous titles were granted.
s0195.idiomatic: Former Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Kuanche, Sichuan Circuit surveillance commissioner Huduruyanga, and others — all were killed by Nangjiatai — posthumous offices and posthumous titles were granted.

s0196.literal: Yuci County clerk Tai Temür and Hezhong Prefecture judge Tutuar — both were killed by Liaodong troops — enhanced posthumous honors were added.
s0196.idiomatic: Yuci County clerk Tai Temür and Hezhong Prefecture judge Tutuar — both were killed by Liaodong troops — enhanced posthumous honors were added.

s0197.literal: On wuwu day, the Emperor presided in the Great Brightness Hall; Yan Temür led civil and military officials, monks and Taoists, and elders — presenting jade registers and jade seal — to offer the honorific title Reverent Heaven, Unifying Sagacity, Perfect Virtue, Sincere Achievement, Great Culture, Filial Emperor.
s0197.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor presided in the Great Brightness Hall; Yan Temür led civil and military officials, monks and Taoists, and elders — presenting jade registers and jade seal — to offer the honorific title Reverent Heaven, Unifying Sagacity, Perfect Virtue, Sincere Achievement, Great Culture, Filial Emperor.

s0198.literal: That day, the era name was changed to Zhishun; announced to the empire.
s0198.idiomatic: That day, the era name was changed to Zhishun; announced to the empire.

s0199.literal: Henan, Huaiqing, Weihui, and Jinning four routes — households that had already received relief — this year's levies were entirely remitted; for the rest among disaster-affected routes' people who had received relief — interior levies and Jiang-Huai summer tax were also remitted three-tenths.
s0199.idiomatic: Henan, Huaiqing, Weihui, and Jinning 4 routes — households that had already received relief — this year's levies were entirely remitted; for the rest among disaster-affected routes' people who had received relief — interior levies and Jiang-Huai summer tax were also remitted three-tenths.

s0200.literal: On jiwei day, Luolosi acting native official pacification commissioner Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, Lai Prefecture native official Deyi rebelled and adhered to Lü Yu.
s0200.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Luolosi acting native official pacification commissioner Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, Lai Prefecture native official Deyi rebelled and adhered to Lü Yu.
